The '''Red Hills''' were a natural formation on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], located between the [[Great Canyon (Dathomir)/Legends|Great Canyon]] and the [[Frenzied River]].<ref name="GatORW" />
These hills were home to the [[Red Hills Clan]] of the [[Witches of Dathomir]].
